incident.name: 3CX Supply Chain Attack
incident.description: Lazarus Group compromised 3CX VoIP software via a prior supply chain attack on Trading Technologies. First known supply chain attack via supply chain.
incident.root_cause: Cascading supply chain compromise, insufficient binary signing verification
incident.lessons: Supply chain attacks can cascade. SBOM and reproducible builds are essential.

relatedIncidents.name: WannaCry Ransomware
relatedIncidents.description: Global ransomware attack exploiting NSA's EternalBlue SMB exploit. Hit 150+ countries, crippled UK NHS.
relatedIncidents.lessons: Patch management and network segmentation are non-negotiable.

relatedIncidents.name: Yahoo Data Breach
relatedIncidents.description: All 3 billion Yahoo accounts compromised. Largest data breach in history. Disclosed 2 years after breach.
relatedIncidents.root_cause: Weak MD5 hashing, no breach detection, delayed disclosure
relatedIncidents.lessons: Strong password hashing (bcrypt/Argon2) and breach detection are essential.

relatedIncidents.name: Sony Pictures Hack
relatedIncidents.description: Destructive attack wiped Sony's network, leaked unreleased films, executive emails, and employee PII. Politically motivated.
relatedIncidents.lessons: Insider threat programs and data classification are critical for media companies.
